title: Request Intake
description: Payload of POST /api/intake/requests — an external app files a user request as an issue in a community workspace. Authenticated with the X-Intake-Token header (TRIBE_INTAKE_TOKEN), not with a user session.

community_id.description: Target community (ULID). The workspace must belong to it.

title.description: Short human title; long requests are trimmed by the caller.

issue_type.description: Platform issue types. Clients map their own kinds: idea → feature, problem → bug, usability → improvement (+ label usability), film → feature (+ label film).

source.description: Where the request came from. `app` and `external_id` make retries idempotent: a second call with the same pair returns the existing issue.

url.description: Page the request was filed from.

external_id.description: Caller-side request id. Repeated submissions return the first issue instead of creating another.

browser_logs.description: JSON string with the client log snapshot; truncated server-side to TRIBE_INTAKE_MAX_LOGS_CHARS.

requester.description: Who filed the request. All fields are optional — an anonymous visitor sends an empty object and the issue is authored by intake:<app>.
